svg.title: Finance, second pass: how the pieces fit — SoftTrack web design mockup (#241)
svg.desc: The first finance epic shipped compensation, payroll runs, claims, reimbursements, budgets and reports. A month of using it showed what it left: nobody is told anything, an employee cannot see their own pay, a claim is an amount and a sentence, a manager has no part in it, and time logged has no price.
svg.text: Finance, second pass: how the pieces fit
· categories, approvals, payslips and billable time

g.text: three places, and two that run through all of it
An amount and a sentence, given something to be counted by.
A manager first, if turned on.
Hours that somebody is charged for.
A switch on a worklog; rates with finance.
Built from what has not been billed.
What a line is made of, and who can read it.
Bonus, allowance, deduction: each its own row.
A person reads what they were paid.
Submitted, decided, paid, and a payslip ready. No amounts in the notification.
Account codes, a journal, and a file for the bank. A file, sent nowhere.
money, and what is not money

svg.text: The two lines from #136 still hold: money is visible to almost nobody, and SoftTrack is the system of record, not the
first: small, and the rest is worse without it
Amounts are integers in the currency’s minor unit with a currency per row, never converted. Approval freezes what it approved. Records are append-only. #295 and #296 go back
on what #133 left out, as options an instance turns on. Each piece has its own mockup on its issue, #292 to #301.
